notes: No published plan available to us shows Harappan architecture at Rakhigarhi with a north arrow. Nath's report on the 1997-2000 excavations reproduces trench sections only, and his site plans in Puratattva 28 (1998) and 31 (2001) show the mounds, roads and trenches without architecture and are marked not to scale. The streets, lanes and house complexes exposed at RGR-1 by Deccan College (2013-16) and by the ASI (2022) have been described in news reports, but we did not find a published plan of them. The town is reported as not measurable from plans.
